description: Passthrough replay: a channel dedicated to streaming a recorded capture verbatim, one file per bandwidth (1 MHz / 20 MHz / 80 MHz). passthrough:true bypasses the mixer (no float bus, noise floor, or other signals) and streams the variant matching the channel's current sample rate straight into VITA-49 packets. Retune the channel bandwidth via REST and it selects the matching file; at 80 MHz it streams the 98.304 MS/s capture with no resampling. A bandwidth with no matching variant renders silence -- passthrough never resamples. The tone sits at +20 MHz within the captured band so it is visible on a waterfall.
